name: Herdr
author: André Conde
description: Herdr workspace monitor for the Omarchy bar: local or remote workspaces with native agent status (waiting/working/done/idle), click to focus, two-click close.

barWidget.description: Polls a Herdr server — local or over SSH — and lists workspaces with the agent state Herdr itself reports.

schema.label: SSH host
schema.description: Leave empty to poll the Herdr server on this machine. Otherwise an SSH host or alias from ~/.ssh/config; polled with plain ssh (BatchMode).

schema.label: Hide idle workspaces
schema.description: Show only workspaces whose agent is waiting, working or done. Useful when you run many workspaces.

schema.label: Herdr binary path
schema.description: Leave empty to auto-detect: ~/.local/bin/herdr if present, otherwise 'herdr' from PATH. Set an explicit path when several Herdr versions are installed (a distro package plus a user install, say).
